[.weftext-query,view=table]
....
from nodes as node
scope workspace
where node.depth >= 0
select node.id
order by node.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=2]
....
from nodes as node
scope workspace
where node.depth >= 0
select node.id
order by node.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1,view=kanban]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.closed = false
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1,view=task-list]
....
from nodes as node
scope workspace
where node.depth >= 0
select node.id
order by node.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1,source=tasks]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.closed = false
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1,version=1]
....
from nodes as node
scope workspace
where node.depth >= 0
select node.id
order by node.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from annotations as annotation
scope workspace
where annotation.id is not null
select annotation.id
order by annotation.id asc
limit 10
....
